text:
tori: New contributor hit a weird logging gap in the sample app with OTEL hooked. Some outbound lines show truncated req_id (only first 8 chars) and an internal IP in headers.

rachel: Can you paste the snippet + how you ran it?

tori: Steps: checkout `samples/onboard-lite`, `npm ci`, then `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=debug TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first ./dev up`. Snip: 
2026-04-02T08:11:01.001Z DEBUG http.send -> POST /v1/chat req_id=abcd1234...
2026-04-02T08:11:01.002Z DEBUG http.send raw-headers: X-Forwarded-For: 10.0.4.12 Authorization: Bearer sk-XXXX
2026-04-02T08:11:01.003Z WARN telemetry req_id truncated in logger output

tori: The token is redacted but the private IP shows. Also req_id appears truncated in several debug lines which makes correlating traces annoying.

mark: Truncation sounds like our log formatter limiting ID length for compactness, but we shouldn't do that for req_id used for triage. The IP leak is concerning. Which SDK version is the sample pinned to?

tori: package.json shows `redwood-sdk: "0.9.0-rc"` — maybe pre-release.

rachel: Two separate issues: (1) req_id formatting policy changed in the log lib in 0.9.0-rc to shorten IDs for noise reduction — we should treat req_id as correlation id and keep full values in debug logs, (2) header redaction currently targets auth/token patterns and emails; we didn't include private IP regex. Also OTEL-first ordering can cause our logging middleware to observe already-emitted debug traces before it injects req_id, resulting in missing or truncated IDs.

mark: Quick fixes: revert the truncation for req_id (log formatter change), add IP pattern to the redaction list, and update sample to a stable SDK or pin to a release that includes the injector fix. Also default sample to `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info` so newcomers don't get overwhelmed.

tori: I can try a local patch: swap to `redwood-sdk@0.9.1` and add a tiny pre-send scrub that replaces private IPs with <redacted_ip> in headers.

rachel: Please keep the scrub conservative and add a unit test that verifies we don't redact public CDN IPs by mistake. Also add a CI integration that runs sample with `TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first` and checks that every debug line has an untruncated `req_id` pattern of 32 hex chars.

infra-bot: Suggested ticket created: INFRA-1342 - add IP redaction + req_id full-length enforcement in sample wrappers.

mark: I'll follow up with the logging-team owner to remove the silent truncation; it caused more harm than benefit for tracing.

tori: Thanks — I'll open a PR with header-scrub + bump to 0.9.1 and toggle `REDWOOD_SCRUB_STRICT=true` behind a flag for now. Leaving my dev env up for validation.

rachel: Nice. Once PR lands, let's add a short Quickstart note: "If debug logs lack full req_ids or show internal IPs, upgrade the sample SDK or set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info while we patch redaction."

tori: Thanks everyone :rocket:
